items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE independent 2D side-scrolling game sprite, the master giant fungal chalice tree for Xeno Prime, Le Berceau enfoui. Input image is ONLY a palette/material/painted world reference; do not reproduce its environment. Subject: a complete tall rooted fungal trunk with a very broad upward-opening shallow chalice cap. The cap is dark matte copper chitin with fine radial ribs and a deeply shadowed underside, supported by a thick charcoal black trunk with intertwined organic tubes. A few tiny dim cyan pores on the trunk. Entire roots spread visibly below and attach to the same tree. Detailed painted concept-art finish matching reference, crisp readable silhouette, side elevation with slight view into the cup. Color palette blackened bark, matte copper, tiny restrained cyan and amber points. Natural overhead light, no outline glow. Canvas square, whole tree centered with generous 10% empty margin all around. Truly transparent alpha background, including between roots; if impossible use perfectly uniform vivid magenta #ff00ff. No landscape, soil platform, fog, floor, floating pieces, outside cast shadow, text, grid or checkerboard. Single complete object only.
